posts.author: Elon2
posts.text: Tipper Ocean Installer ! Dof selger fartøy: DOF Group ASA (“DOF”) has agreed to sell the 2018-built subsea construction vessel Skandi Implementer to an undisclosed buyer. The vessel is planned to be delivered to its new owner in Q2 2027. The sale will contribute to a material reduction in the Group’s net debt.

posts.author: svisj
posts.text: Spørs, Ocean Installer leier skipene sine.
